rule_1.name: TIME_REF_IS_EXACT_AND_OPAQUE_AT_THE_SUBSTRATE_GRAIN
rule_1.meaning: No code below the rule layer may assume a grain. A time ref is an exact ref; the grain lives in the binding authority.

rule_2.name: GRAIN_IS_BOUND_BY_EXACT_TEMPORAL_EVIDENCE_AUTHORITY
rule_2.meaning: A claim may use a grain only to the extent the governing rule's exact TEMPORAL_EVIDENCE authority admits it.
current_mechanism: the rule declares which exact time refs are in scope (allowed_effective_time_or_interval_refs, rawlsing_next/pre553_structural_admission.py:218)
the target use declares which exact time refs it requires (effective_time_or_interval_refs_required_by_target_use, :369)
the rule must bind exact TEMPORAL_EVIDENCE authority for any time ref it uses (:281-282)
admission compares by exact-ref membership and emits TEMPORAL_SCOPE_MISMATCH on failure (:673-678)
rule_2.consequence: A source could lawfully be used with a point-year ref in one operation and a bounded interval ref in another, because the bound authority differs. Different operations may lawfully carry different exact time representations. This polymorphism IS the law and is preserved deliberately.

rule_3.name: NO_IMPLICIT_GRAIN_COERCION
rule_3.meaning: No midpoint, no year-from-ordinal, no ordinal-as-date, no interval-to-point collapse, and no interpolation as a substitute time ref.
rule_3.historical_support: data/ddm_build_copy/ddm_v553_temporal_identity.py:30-46,129-144, which accepts temporal_year / fieldwork_year / survey_year / year in 1000..3000, REFUSES to treat a wave ordinal as a year, and requires one anchor per calendar year. Fieldwork intervals are not represented there.
rule_3.status: HISTORICAL_CONSTRAINT, conservable, adopted by this contract

rule_4.name: WAVE_LABEL != ORDINAL != CALENDAR_YEAR
rule_4.meaning: The canonical wave is a LABEL. The ordinal is derived only for range comparison and only without changing the canonical label. The calendar year is a separate quantity. None may be substituted for another.
rule_4.historical_support: data/ddm_build_copy/ddm_survey_identity.py:123-159,204-215 - canonical_wave_key preserves the wave as a LABEL (II, W6, ROUND9, 2017); wave_ordinal is derived only 'for range-comparison' and 'without changing the canonical label'.
rule_4.binding: This must survive composition of the temporal_identity_contract_ref and must survive any order basis. A wave label MUST NOT be coerced to a calendar year, and an ordinal MUST NOT be reported as a date.

rule_5.name: OVERLAPPING_INTERVALS_GIVE_A_PARTIAL_ORDER
rule_5.meaning: Where two authorized interval refs overlap, the order is partial and no direction is claimable for that pair.
rule_5.no_midpoint: Overlap MUST NOT be coerced to a midpoint. That would fabricate an order the sources do not support.

rule_6.name: DIFFERENT_OPERATIONS_MAY_CARRY_DIFFERENT_GRAINS
rule_6.meaning: Polymorphism is preserved deliberately. No universal grain is adopted and none is required.
rule_6.status: This is the direct answer to the withdrawn fork: the fork was never lawful, and polymorphism replaces it.

rule_7.name: NO_SURVEY_FAMILY_MEMBERSHIP_PROOF_OF_GRAIN_ADEQUACY
rule_7.meaning: Same-family membership does not by itself prove that a point-year ref is adequate for a comparison. Adequacy is per-claim and per-authority.

rule_8.name: NO_SCALAR_ELIGIBILITY
rule_8.meaning: Eligibility for a temporal comparison MUST NOT depend on the presence of a scalar value. No scalar pressure field, coefficient, threshold or inherited deadband determines comparability.

order_basis_kinds.note: These four kinds are jointly exhaustive and mutually exclusive for the cases the commission names. No fifth kind is derived and no general temporal algebra is authorized.

kinds.meaning: Order is established by exact calendar position, where exact points or non-overlapping intervals permit it.
preconditions: both anchors' time representations are exact calendar quantities under bound TEMPORAL_EVIDENCE authority
the two calendar extents are exact points, or intervals that do not overlap
the canonical calendar mapping material is adopted or bound
the pair satisfies the comparability requirement set
kinds.explicitly_not: This is NOT a claim that calendar time is the universal grain. It is the basis selected for THIS pair under THIS authority.

kinds.meaning: Order is established by a specifically authorized family-local wave ordinal.
kinds.authorization_is_mandatory: A family-local ordinal basis is lawful ONLY where specifically authorized for that family. It is never assumed from same-family membership (rule_7).
kinds.hard_constraint: The canonical wave LABEL is preserved unchanged. The ordinal is used only for ordering and never replaces the label. WAVE_LABEL != ORDINAL != CALENDAR_YEAR is binding here.
must_not: convert the ordinal to a calendar year
report the ordinal as a date
generalize a family-scoped ordinal into a cross-family or universal order
treat the ordinal as comparable with a calendar-year quantity
kinds.historical_note: The historically hard-coded EVS_WAVE_BY_YEAR table (data/ddm_build_copy/ddm_survey_identity.py:89) is family-specific harmonization material, not a general grain rule, and may not be generalized. Where such mapping is required and unadopted, the outcome is TEMPORAL_MAPPING_MATERIAL_ABSENT.

kinds.meaning: The authorized time representations determine only a partial order over this pair, so no direction is claimable.
kinds.typical_trigger: The two authorized interval refs overlap.
kinds.no_midpoint: Partial order MUST NOT be resolved to a midpoint, a representative date, or any other single time ref.
kinds.still_comparable: A partial-order pair may still be COMPARABLE. Comparability and direction are separate.

kinds.meaning: No permitted order basis applies, or the temporal ordering is unknown or non-comparable under bound authority.
kinds.refusal_state: TEMPORAL_NONCOMPARABLE or TEMPORAL_ORDER_UNAUTHORIZED, as the reason code dictates
kinds.no_guess: Unknown ordering MUST NOT be resolved by latest/default/fuzzy/nearest selection. FORBIDDEN_SELECTOR_TOKENS (rawlsing_next/pre553_empirical_authority.py:58-60) remains binding.
kinds.no_clock: No clock or environment state may substitute for an unknown order.

current_adopted_time_surfaces.finding: The current adopted substrate does NOT validate grain. Time refs are exact and grain-free at the substrate; grain lives in bound authority.

surfaces.finding: Names EITHER a point OR an interval and constrains neither. No grain enum, no grain validation, no grain assertion, no grain comparison in the module.
Also exact refs, compared by membership against the rule's allowed set.
Free mappings that are only canonicalised and hashed. No grain semantics.

adopting any grain enum at the substrate layer
